column1: # ASN name snapshot bundled into the control plane.
# Format: <as number><TAB><organization name>
#   - `AS`/`as` prefix, blank lines and `#` comments are accepted.
#   - One tab separates the number from the name; the name may contain spaces,
#     commas and dots (it may not contain a tab).
#   - Malformed lines are skipped with a warning; they never fail startup.
# Provenance: hand-curated from the public RIR/PeeringDB registrations of the
# networks that dominate internet traffic (CDNs, hyperscalers, large ISPs and
# hosting providers). It is a *snapshot*, not an authoritative registry: an
# operator who needs complete or freshly verified coverage exports a
# two-column TSV from PeeringDB (or any ASN→organization source) and points
# WAFRED_ASN_NAMES_FILE at it — entries there override the ones below.
# Anything still unresolved is rendered as `Unknown (AS<number>)`, never as a
# bare number.
# Entries are grouped by category for reviewability; the parser does not care
# about order and a later line for the same AS number replaces an earlier one.
